title: ACIS peer validator and normalization boundary
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan update
scope: Inspect the actual ACadRust ACIS validation and mutating normalization API boundaries
Separate peer self-roundtrip and generated primitive evidence from independent geometry evidence
Reconcile acis-core/cq-acis parser and OpenCascade kernel lineage
Keep FreeCAD explicit-entity import separate from embedded ACIS consumption
Turn optional structural comparison into a bounded, self-unblocking implementation recipe

sources.observation: The published 0.5.5 API describes structural pointer/topology validation; separate mutating APIs fill missing vertex-edge/edge-coedge links or remove non-core records and remap references. SabReader maps bytes into a SatDocument. This supports a candidate structural parser comparison but not geometric-kernel validity. The docs version must not be assigned to the moving repository's 0.6.5 release without artifact/source reconciliation.

The current test file includes generated planar geometry passed through the same project's DWG writer and reader, as well as marker-shaped fake SAB bytes used in a transport test helper. These tests are useful self-consistency and preservation evidence only; the moving branch must be pinned before release-specific attribution.

acis-core documents its own typed model and bounded SAB/ASM parsing while explicitly not constructing OCCT solids. cq-acis documents conversion of a supported subset through CadQuery/OpenCascade. Count these as one parser-plus-kernel lineage, not independent votes or general ACIS coverage.

The current guide documents separate C++ and legacy DXF entity subsets and says stock DXF import cannot read embedded binary ACIS/SAT. DWG helper routes invoke a selected converter before DXF import; converter completion is not evidence that a solid body was consumed.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S3/S8: separate raw SAT/SAB parsing, untouched graph validation, repair/normalization, shape construction, independent geometric measurement, and native acceptance
PAR-07/S8: pin peer artifact and API identity; preserve raw/unsupported records and source-reference occurrence before any mutating helper
S2/S8: distinguish FreeCAD converter completion, strict DXF parse, explicit-entity import, and ACIS body semantics
assessment.planImpact: Only optional structural-peer admission details were sharpened. Validate an untouched peer model before invoking helpers that complete topology links or strip/remap records. Neither peer self-roundtrip nor structural validation promotes geometry support; independent kernel/application evidence remains separately required.

method.limitations: ACadRust docs.rs pages identify v0.5.5, while the repository has a newer release; current moving tests were not bound to an immutable source artifact. Peer API/test claims were not executed. The FreeCAD documentation constrains documented importer capability but is not a runtime qualification. No new geometry truth or support evidence was obtained.
